`array_keys(stat($p))` is a compile error in elephc and ordinary php: php compiles it and throws
`TypeError: array_keys(): Argument #1 ($array) must be of type array, false given` only when the
value really is false. The mechanism for that already exists — `ARRAY_OR_FALSE_ARG_SITES` names 24
argument slots — and `array_keys` is simply not one of them.

A table that covers 24 of N is the catalogue-as-promise shape, so this asks the registry which
